title: Cart counter in header updates after adding a product
description: Loads the shop, confirms the header cart counter starts at zero and the cart is empty, adds one product to the cart, confirms the cart is no longer empty, and then checks the header cart link shows one item.
preconditions: The application is reachable at the base URL
The product list shows 'Mechanical Keyboard' with an 'Add to cart' button
The cart is empty at the start of the session

steps.description: The header cart link shows zero items before anything is added
The shopping cart region reports it is empty before anything is added
After adding the product, the cart no longer reports being empty
The header cart link should show one item after adding a single product

metadata.symptom: When I add a product to the cart, the cart counter at the top of the page doesn't go up.
